title: reading-notes-llm-inference-noor-hassan
content:
Reading notes - LLM inference optimizations (Feb 2026)

Papers / posts reviewed:
- "Speculative Decoding for Faster Inference" (arXiv 2023) - key idea: run a small model to predict tokens and validate with large model; large model only verifies/scoring; big wins for throughput when batch/computation costs favor small model.
- "KV cache sharding and streaming" (notes from systems blog) - tradeoffs for sharding KV across GPUs vs replication; streaming full-attention with prefix caching avoids recompute but increases memory overhead.
- "Multi-Query Attention and MQA's memory tradeoffs" - reduces KV memory by sharing K/V, but impacts model parallelism and throughput when sequence lengths vary.
- "Quantization-aware compilation" - kernel selection + 4-bit quantization heuristics; importance of per-layer profiles rather than one-size-fits-all.

Takeaways for Redwood serving runtime:
- Speculative decoding is promising for high-throughput use cases (long responses + tolerant apps). Need prototype to measure end-to-end latency vs token-level throughput. Action: create a small POC using a 1.5B assistant model as speculator and 13B as verifier; measure on Dedicated GPU pool.
- KV cache: implement hybrid strategy - replicate small prefix cache for low-latency tail requests, shard longer contexts for batch workloads. Add metrics to Console to surface KV hit/miss ratio per route.
- MQA: useful when memory is the bottleneck, but watch out for its interaction with sharded tensor parallelism. Flag in model catalog with recommended deployments.
- Quantization: collect per-model/per-layer quant stats in Optimize pipeline; feed into kernel-selection heuristics.

Quick experiments to run:
1) Speculative POC (owner: Noor) - infra: dev-dedicated-1, models: tiny->large chain, metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per token. Target: end-to-end latency improvement >=20% for long-generation workloads.
2) KV cache stress test (owner: Harini) - simulate mixed traffic (short chat vs long generation) and measure memory footprint and latency SLO violations.
3) Quantization safety net (owner: Ethan) - run regression eval harness with production prompt set for 5 candidate quant profiles.

Open questions / notes-to-self:
- How does speculative decoding interact with function calling? Need design doc for verifier fallback when tools invoked.
- Is there a simple signal to choose between replicated vs sharded KV? Possibly based on request seq_len distribution and request rate per model.
- Linked to RED-3421 (speculative-decoding spike) - sync with infra for resource allocation.

References and links:
- Speculative decoding paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13538
- MQA notes: https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.05298
- Internal spike ticket: RED-3421

Notes ended: next step - add brief POC plan to Confluence and request 2 GPU-days for prototype.
